findings.evidence: spec.md line 67 specifies `ice-blue #chatMessagesContainer (#EBF3FC)`, whereas plan.md line 56 specifies `#chatMessagesContainer { ... background: transparent; }` over the page `--bg-gradient` (`#E8F1FA` -> `#EEF5FC` -> `#E3EEF9`).
findings.impact: Visually both produce an ice-blue background inside the 480px chat shell, but `background: transparent` makes `getComputedStyle(container).backgroundColor` evaluate to `rgba(0, 0, 0, 0)` instead of `rgb(235, 243, 252)` (`#EBF3FC`) if AC-007 tests check computed background color, and exposes gradient shift behind scrolled messages.
findings.recommendation: Align plan.md (and the implementation in frontend/index.html) to `background: #EBF3FC;` on `#chatMessagesContainer` to match spec.md REQ-007 and the desktop mockup (`聊天室.png`).
findings.verification_condition: In frontend/index.html and plan.md, `#chatMessagesContainer` resolves `getComputedStyle(document.getElementById('chatMessagesContainer')).backgroundColor` to `'rgb(235, 243, 252)'` (`#EBF3FC`) while `#chatModal` outer desktop margins remain transparent over the page gradient.
